notes: HHC in quest escrows is the ASIN-HHC network's issued utility credit for verified work (mesh ledger). Rewards are issued, not bought; no cash prizes, no price talk, no promises — proof only.

quests.settlement: Two independent verifiers re-fetch the claim and compare; PASS pays 90% to the winner, 10% split by verifiers (paid on any verdict). Verdict receipts are public either way.
quests.title: Seal the Index

quests.sponsor_terms: Whoever funds the pool names the quest theme (within the rules) and takes a permanent Sponsor row on the board. Escrow is created and receipted publicly before the quest is announced.
quests.title: Opens when funded
